universe.scope: every eligible symbol crossed with every XNYS session in its eligible month
universe.ranking_semantics: all eligible symbols remain in the same session and decision-clock cross-section
universe.missing_policy: explicit unavailable row; no fill, cash substitution, provider splice, or silent symbol removal

clock_grid.decision_prior: last valid SIP quote strictly before completed signal bar, maximum age 120 seconds
clock_grid.entry: first valid SIP quote at or after signal cutoff, maximum wait 120 seconds
clock_grid.delay_entry_5m: first valid SIP quote at or after signal cutoff plus five minutes, maximum wait 120 seconds
clock_grid.exits: first valid SIP quote at or after each frozen holding horizon, maximum wait 120 seconds

immutability.partitioning: calendar month, session date, decision bar, deterministic symbol batch
